items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: And Mark Johnson the bass player. And Mark is like tremendously busy. And Mark Feldman on violin. So just trying to get four of us together to commit to like two periods of time was really hard but we finally got it.

ctx.x: Does that ever — do you ever juggle yourself into a corner with your commitments?

It’s happened, yeah. I try not to let it happen. I mean I’m usually pretty on top of it but I know there’s been some occasions where I did get a phone call and they said, “Well don’t you remember you said the last three weeks of October you would put aside?” And I say, “I did?” And I go back into my date book and I look in my little computer and I look through the little saved e-mails and all this stuff, this is technology, and I’m looking going gee I can’t find anything are you sure? Well I remember the…
Right. For our guitar viewers, what’s your instrument of choice these days?
